## 1. What learner or contributor problem does this solve?

One or two sentences: who was stuck, and on what.

## 2. What changed?

The change in plain terms, the changelog bullet you added under `[Unreleased]` (or "no changelog entry" and why), and whether an AI assistant helped.

## 3. Which automated checks passed, and where?

The gates you ran (`just preflight`, focused pytest, `just e2e` if you touched the web layer) and the path to any evidence.

## 4. Which live or manual journey did you check yourself?

What you did by hand, with which harness or browser, and what you saw.

## 5. What remains unverified?

Name it honestly; "nothing" is an acceptable answer only when it is true.
